leakage_analysis.note: G1/G2 are prior-period grades and are strongly correlated with the final grade G3 by construction. Numbers below show how much of the model's accuracy actually comes from G1/G2 vs. the behavioural/demographic features. The deployed model still uses G1/G2 because the product intentionally asks users for their in-progress grades, but this is reported here for transparency.

deployed_model.reasoning: Each candidate was scored with the same 5-fold cross-validation; the model with the higher CV score was deployed rather than defaulting to Random Forest.
